changelog.summary: Adds a generic order exception to support update proposal with exact order and case joins and a rejected false-resolution example.

title: Order Exception to Reviewed Update
description: Investigate a cross-system order exception and prepare a policy-safe, unsent customer update for the exact support case.
setup_prompt: Use Order Exception to Reviewed Update as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Operations and Support Crews, one exact order and case, payment, fulfillment, carrier, prior contact, current policy and owners. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, a blocking order artifact validator before Support reads it, and one manual exception. Show the plan before Builder applies it. Selection does not send a message, refund, reship, alter an order or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Business, exact order, payment, fulfillment and shipment IDs
Exact support case, customer, recipient and channel
Current order, payment, fulfillment, carrier and case records
Promised time, exception thresholds, customer contact policy and owners
Manual-only or reviewed event and cadence

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create a reviewed missing Operations or Support Crew with a stable key

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass a validated bounded order exception artifact

recommended_tools.name: Commerce or ERP order source
recommended_tools.purpose: Read exact order, payment and fulfillment state

recommended_tools.name: Carrier or fulfillment source
recommended_tools.purpose: Read accepted, in-transit and delivered events by shipment ID

recommended_tools.name: Support case source
recommended_tools.purpose: Read current case, recipient and prior contact; send only through a separate approved route

pulse_focus.label: Order exception follow-through
focus_areas: Whether source states and customer-facing claims still agree
Whether an exception has an owner and a safe next check
review_when: The order, payment, carrier or case revision changes, or the promised time passes

outputs: Reviewed Operations and Support Crew bindings
Current case-linked unsent customer update or explicit no-message decision
Owner review and manual run evidence
